purpose: Pass H1 join ledger: which (collection, book_number) pairs the app can name, and what upstream could and could not supply. The NAMES themselves stay in each bundled edition's metadata.sections (the loader's existing join) — this file adds no name data and duplicates none.

upstream.license: The Unlicense (repo-level public-domain grant; per-translator licensing UNKNOWN)
upstream.nativeBookNamesNote: Every edition's metadata.sections dict — including ara-* and urd-* — is the SAME English dict (verified against the cloned repo, 2026-09-25). No Arabic/Urdu book names exist upstream; none were invented here.

joinRule: by (collection, book_number) on metadata.sections keys; POSITIONAL joins are wrong by construction (language files differ in record count: muslim/urdu +1, malik/urdu +31)
fallbackNote: Rendered via the app's i18n label (hadithKitabLabel) when a referenced book number carries no section name in any edition.
